title: Controller discovery and real inventory

actions.description: started gns3server bound to 127.0.0.1:3080 (command-line only; persistent configuration unchanged)
infraflow-provider gns3 inventory (credentials from INFRAFLOW_GNS3_* environment)
actions.result: first run exposed a client decoding defect (float cpus); fixed, re-run

final_state: controller reachable on loopback only, v3 API, bearer authentication

checks.name: version
checks.expected: API version and server version reported by /v3/version

checks.name: authentication
checks.expected: bearer token from /v3/access/users/authenticate; HTTP Basic refused by v3

checks.name: templates
checks.expected: every template listed with image availability checked, none guessed
checks.observed: 30 templates; 28 images present; IOL-XE (iol-xe/iol-xe:17-18-02) and Mikrotik WinBox (gns3/mikrotik-winbox) absent

checks.name: host resources
checks.expected: CPU, RAM, disk read before any node is started
checks.observed: 8 vCPU, 7.1 GiB available RAM, 56.9 GiB free disk

warnings: controller uses the default admin/admin account; change it before exposing the server
the controller lists a remote compute that was unreachable; /v3/statistics blocks on it
status_reason: inventory collected from the real controller with no missing section
